changelog.title: What's New in 8.0.1
items: SteamLite 8.0.1 is now available with hotfixes for the settings page UI
Fixed Change Profile button accessibility - moved outside account card for better access
Fixed username truncation in settings page - usernames now display fully without cutting off
Improved layout and spacing for profile management controls
All 8.0.0 features remain intact including the complete UI rework and new feature set

news.title: SteamLite 8.0.1 Hotfix Available
news.content: SteamLite 8.0.1 is now available with hotfixes for the settings page. The Change Profile button has been moved outside the account card for better accessibility, and username truncation has been fixed to display full usernames. All 8.0.0 features including the major UI rework, new theme system, and enhanced profile page remain intact.

news.title: We Are Hiring!
news.content: Want to help build the future of SteamLite? We are looking to expand the team! Come down to the GitHub Discussions page to get started and find out how you can join the project.

news.title: SteamLite 8.0.0 Major Update
news.content: SteamLite 8.0.0 brought a complete UI rework with modern profile pages, enhanced collections system, SteamID-based theme authorship, 25 themes, 24 achievements, developer mode, and many more improvements. Check out the full changelog for details.
